court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sumeet Subhash Kumar Thr Poa Subhash ... vs Shirin Sumeet Kumar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sumeet Subhash Kumar Through PoA ] Subhash Ramruch Kumar

facts_of_case: Parties are desirous of prosecuting their divorce petition and have arrived at a consensus to convert the said petition into a petition for mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to establish that the marriage has been broken down irretrievably.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking divorce to establish that the marriage has been broken down irretrievably.

legal_principles.principle: A mutual consent divorce can be granted if the parties have a genuine intention to part ways.
legal_principles.held: It is held that a mutual consent divorce can be granted if the parties have a genuine intention to part ways.

outcome.final_order: The parties will deliberate upon the proposals exchanged between them. The matter is listed on 14/07/2022 at 2:00 p.m.
